text_to_speech: How far 10 dollars will take us to India with this taxi. -Ready? -Ready. This is India. Hello. -Hello, how are you? -Very good. I love Indian people. They were so excited to see me in the rickshaw. It's been almost an hour that we are in this rickshaw and we only spend 3 dollars. It’s so cheap, right? Yes. In the United States for an hour, 100 dollars. 100 dollars. We kept going for another 30 minutes. But, then…. look guys, we are stuck in traffic. Hello, friend. Hello. He's taking a picture in the middle of the traffic guys. I love you. Have a great day. The traffic started to move and I asked the driver if I could drive. I was so excited, that I kissed him. So after three hours, we finally travel 80 k.m. -for 10 dollars. -Thank you.
